purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) processing system - preview/check list print from preview DB
purpose.summary: This program (ORCBPRVPRT) is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system. It reads from a preview database and prints a receipt check list, reporting errors found during receipt validation. It processes patient information, insurance details, and outputs a formatted error/check list report.

notable_features: 18 CALL statements including ORCSJOB for job management
UNSTRING of COMMAND-PARAM for parameter parsing
MCP (Message Control Program) database access pattern
Japanese text in comments and data literals (Shift-JIS/EUC-JP encoded)
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for shell invocation
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary MCP DB layer
verdict.notes: Source contains Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, decoded as latin-1 resulting in mojibake in the visible text. File is truncated at 16000 chars out of 29455 bytes (737 lines total). The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system used widely in Japanese medical clinics.
